confirm.title: Pair {name}
confirm.description: Close the Acova Control app and switch the radiator on. After you submit, if light 2 flashes green, press the 2H boost button (3) within 30 seconds. An already bonded radiator does not need this.

progress.pairing: Connecting. When the green light flashes, press the 2H boost button on the radiator.

error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check that the phone app is closed and the radiator is on, then try again and press the 2H button while the light flashes.

abort.already_configured: This radiator is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No radiator found over Bluetooth. Check that it is on and in range of the Bluetooth adapter.

init.title: Weekly schedule
init.description: Blocks in this Schedule helper become comfort hours and everything else becomes eco. Times are widened to whole hours.

sync_schedule.name: Sync schedule
sync_schedule.description: Writes the chosen Schedule helper to the radiator.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to write. Leave empty for the whole week.
